items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: He simply informed me of what is happening

ctx.x: them. What has been important is what their music has done to me. To me; not for me.

By the way, we probably should get on tape, if you wish, what you mentioned about George Simon calling you this morning and saying they are interested in putting out a recording of some of the Sauter-Finegan material. Do you want to describe that?
More than that I don't know. He simply informed me of what is happening, he's putting the thing together for the Franklin Society. Beyond that I really don't know.
